paragraphs.text: Liberator was the planeswalker Urza 's legendary battlethopter during the Brothers' War on Dominaria .

Liberator was capable of flight using its flapping sails. A large vehicle, it was able to carry several of Urza's mechanical units at once. One of its shield plates was styled in the likeness of Urza himself, and it was armed with eight mana cannons, capable of firing both forward and backward while unloading its battalion of mechs.
